title: 5 AI prompts every *manager* should save
subtitle: Copy, paste, fill in the [brackets]. Works in any AI chat.

slides.title: Give feedback that *lands*
slides.when: When you need to say something hard, kindly.
slides.prompt: Help me give feedback to a team member about [the issue]. Be kind but clear. Use 3 parts: what I saw, why it matters, what I need next.

slides.title: Weekly update for *your boss*
slides.when: When your notes are a mess on Friday afternoon.
slides.prompt: Turn these notes into a 5-bullet weekly update for my manager: [paste notes]. Group them into wins, risks and next steps.

slides.title: Share *tough news* with your team
slides.when: Before a change, delay or reorg announcement.
slides.prompt: I need to tell my team [the news]. Write 3 short talking points, then list the 3 questions they'll most likely ask, with honest answers.

slides.title: A meeting agenda in *seconds*
slides.when: So the meeting ends with decisions, not more meetings.
slides.prompt: Create a 30-minute agenda for a meeting about [topic]. Include the goal, time for each item, and the decisions we need to make.

slides.title: Draft a *performance review*
slides.when: When you're staring at a blank review form.
slides.prompt: Help me write a balanced performance review for someone who is strong at [strengths] but needs to improve [area]. Be specific. Under 150 words.
slides.tip: **Tip:** leave out names and private details. Always edit the draft so it's in your own words.

endBig: Comment *TEAM* for 5 more prompts like these
endSmall: One AI tip for work, every day.
caption:
